name: live_inputs_dock
description: OSC-3c: View > Live Inputs brings the dock forward. The user's OSC listener is off in a fresh profile; turning it on with port 0 and Apply saves the per-user setting and restarts the engine with --osc-port, and the dock reports the port the operating system chose. Turning it off and applying restarts without a listener, and the dock says so. The table and the listener line are the engine's answer, never a local guess.
